title: Frames
description: Fleet telemetry exported by the backend from each frame's latest heartbeat, filterable per frame, release version and build sha. Connectivity and events come from the logs.

list.name: frame
list.label: Frame
list.description: Frame serial number, from the registered frames in the database.

list.name: version
list.label: Version
list.description: Release version (X.Y.Z) the frame reports. The only semver of the three, and the one the OTA compare uses.

list.name: os_sha
list.label: OS SHA
list.description: shareframe-hardware commit the OS image was built from. A -dirty suffix means the build tree had uncommitted changes.

list.name: app_sha
list.label: App SHA
list.description: shareframe-board commit the application binaries were built from, compiled into them at build time.

list.name: search
list.label: Search
list.description: Substring filter for the raw heartbeat payloads panel.

targets.expr: avg(shareframe_frame_cpu_usage_percent and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"})

avg((1 - shareframe_frame_ram_available_bytes / shareframe_frame_ram_total_bytes) * 100 and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"})
avg(shareframe_frame_cpu_temp_celsius and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"})

panels.title: Registered frames

targets.expr: count(shareframe_frame_active{serial_number=~"$frame"})

panels.description: Frames in the database, whether or not they have ever reported.

panels.title: Frames reporting

targets.expr: count(shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"})

panels.description: Frames that sent a heartbeat within the last 15 minutes.

panels.title: Silent frames

targets.expr: count((time() - shareframe_frame_last_seen_timestamp_seconds{serial_number=~"$frame"}) > 900) or vector(0)

panels.description: Registered frames whose Frame.last_seen is older than 15 minutes. Heartbeats arrive every 5 minutes; websocket messages from the frame count too. Counts against the database roster, so it no longer depends on what happens to be in the log range.

panels.title: Never seen

targets.expr: (count(shareframe_frame_active{serial_number=~"$frame"}) - count(shareframe_frame_last_seen_timestamp_seconds{serial_number=~"$frame"})) or vector(0)

panels.description: Registered frames with no Frame.last_seen at all - they have never checked in.

panels.title: Unhealthy

targets.expr: count(shareframe_frame_health{check="overall", status!="ok"} and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}) or vector(0)

panels.description: Frames whose latest heartbeat reports health_state other than ok.

panels.title: Service down

targets.expr: count(count by (serial_number) (shareframe_frame_service_running{service=~"websocket|display|dashboard|update"} == 0 and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"})) or vector(0)

panels.description: Frames whose last heartbeat reported dashboard, display, update or websocket not running.

panels.title: Reboots in range

targets.expr: sum(max_over_time(shareframe_frame_boot_count{serial_number=~"$frame"}[$__range]) - min_over_time(shareframe_frame_boot_count{serial_number=~"$frame"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.description: Sum over frames of how far boot_count advanced within the range.

panels.title: Fleet roster
panels.description: Every registered frame, straight from the database. One row per frame by construction: public_serial_number is unique, so nothing here can duplicate or go missing when a frame changes address or firmware. Last seen is the Frame.last_seen column, refreshed by websocket traffic as well as heartbeats, so it can be newer than Last heartbeat below. Owner is the email of the assigned user, blank if the frame has none.

targets.expr: sum by (serial_number, version, local_ip_address, owner_email) (shareframe_frame_info{serial_number=~"$frame"})
sum by (serial_number) (shareframe_frame_active{serial_number=~"$frame"})
sum by (serial_number) (shareframe_frame_last_seen_timestamp_seconds{serial_number=~"$frame"}) * 1000
sum by (serial_number) (shareframe_frame_last_connected_timestamp_seconds{serial_number=~"$frame"}) * 1000
sum by (serial_number) (shareframe_frame_websocket_connected{serial_number=~"$frame"})
sum by (serial_number) (shareframe_frame_registered_timestamp_seconds{serial_number=~"$frame"}) * 1000
sum by (serial_number) (shareframe_frame_last_update_check_timestamp_seconds{serial_number=~"$frame"}) * 1000
sum by (serial_number) (shareframe_frame_last_update_attempt_timestamp_seconds{serial_number=~"$frame"}) * 1000

panels.title: Latest telemetry per frame

panels.description: One row per registered frame, newest values. Identity and Last seen come from the database, so a frame appears even when it is offline - telemetry columns stay empty then, because telemetry is only exported for frames that sent a heartbeat within the last 15 minutes. Last seen tracks websocket traffic too, so it can be newer than Last heartbeat.

panels.title: Heartbeat presence

targets.expr: sum by (serial_number) (count_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~".+", serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"} [$__interval]))

panels.description: Heartbeat arrival per frame over time, one row per frame.

panels.title: Websocket connections

targets.expr: sum (count_over_time({job="backend", logger="websockets.frames"} |= "New connection accepted" [$__interval]))
sum (count_over_time({job="backend", logger="websockets.frames"} |= "Connection disconnected" [$__interval]))
sum (count_over_time({job="backend", logger="websockets.frames"} |= "Connection rejected" [$__interval]))

panels.description: Fleet-wide. These lines identify frames by database id, not serial, so the frame filter does not apply to them.

panels.title: Disconnect close codes

targets.expr: sum by (close_code) (count_over_time({job="backend", logger="websockets.frames"} |= "Connection disconnected" | regexp `with code (?P<close_code>\d+)` [$__interval]))

panels.description: 1000 is a clean close, 1006 an abnormal drop.

panels.title: Stale connections reaped

targets.expr: sum (count_over_time({job="backend", logger="celery.frames"} |= "Closed and deleted" [$__interval]))

panels.description: Connections the Celery reaper closed after the inactivity timeout.

panels.title: Release versions

targets.expr: count by (version) (shareframe_frame_info{serial_number=~"$frame"})

panels.description: Frames per version, from the database. A frame that updated inside the range counts once, under its current version.

panels.title: Uptime

targets.expr: shareframe_frame_uptime_seconds and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}

panels.description: A drop back to zero is a reboot.

panels.title: Boot count

targets.expr: shareframe_frame_boot_count and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}

panels.description: Every step up is a boot.

panels.title: Build provenance per frame
panels.description: Release, OS and app commit plus kernel each frame reported in its latest heartbeat.

targets.expr: max by (serial_number, version, os_sha, app_sha, kernel) (shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"})
shareframe_frame_cpu_temp_celsius and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}

(1 - shareframe_frame_ram_available_bytes / shareframe_frame_ram_total_bytes) * 100 and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}
shareframe_frame_cpu_temp_celsius and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}
shareframe_frame_cpu_usage_percent and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}

(1 - shareframe_frame_ram_available_bytes / shareframe_frame_ram_total_bytes) * 100 and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}
shareframe_frame_load_1 and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}
shareframe_frame_load_5 and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}
shareframe_frame_load_15 and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}

(1 - shareframe_frame_storage_data_free_bytes / shareframe_frame_storage_data_total_bytes) * 100 and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}
shareframe_frame_storage_data_free_bytes and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}

panels.title: Data written per day
panels.description: KiB the frame wrote to its /data partition (f2fs lifetime counter) over the trailing 24h. Catches write amplification before it wears out the SD card. A factory reset restarts the counter.

targets.expr: (max_over_time(shareframe_frame_data_written_kb[1d]) - min_over_time(shareframe_frame_data_written_kb[1d])) and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}

panels.title: SD card per frame
panels.description: Card identity from the SD controller (name, manufacturer and OEM id, manufacturing date) with the lifetime KiB written to /data, to tie card failures to a brand or batch.

targets.expr: sum by (serial_number, sd_card) (shareframe_frame_data_written_kb * on (serial_number) group_left (sd_card) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"})

panels.title: Image refreshes

targets.expr: shareframe_frame_display_epd_image_refresh_total and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}

panels.description: Image refreshes since first use (epd_image_refresh_total). Every step up is an image shown.

panels.title: Display failures

targets.expr: shareframe_frame_display_epd_refresh_fail_total and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}
shareframe_frame_display_epd_poweron_fail_total and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}

panels.description: Failed panel refreshes and power-ons since first use. Every step up is a failure.

panels.title: Refresh duration

targets.expr: shareframe_frame_display_epd_last_refresh_ms and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}

panels.description: Duration of the last panel refresh. Creeping up hints at a tired panel or BUSY-pin trouble.

panels.title: Consecutive display failures

targets.expr: shareframe_frame_display_consecutive_failures and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}

panels.description: Failure streak; 3 or more means the display reports failed.

panels.title: Images on frame

targets.expr: shareframe_frame_image_count and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}

panels.description: Pictures stored on the frame at each heartbeat (image_count).

panels.title: App crashes

targets.expr: shareframe_frame_crash_count and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}

panels.description: Persistent count of app service crashes (non-zero exit or fatal signal).

panels.title: Unclean resets

targets.expr: shareframe_frame_unclean_resets and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}

panels.description: Boots without a clean shutdown: power pulled, watchdog or panic. Pulling the plug is normal.

panels.title: WiFi signal

targets.expr: shareframe_frame_wlan_signal_dbm and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}

panels.description: wlan0 signal strength.

panels.title: Heap per service

targets.expr: shareframe_frame_process_heap_bytes and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}

panels.description: VmData per app service (heap + thread stacks). Steady growth across days = leak.

panels.title: RSS per service

targets.expr: shareframe_frame_process_rss_bytes and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}

panels.description: Resident memory per app service.

panels.title: Threads & fds per service

targets.expr: shareframe_frame_process_threads and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}
shareframe_frame_process_fds and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}

panels.description: Threads and open file descriptors per app service; growth = leak.

panels.title: Peaks this boot

targets.expr: shareframe_frame_temp_peak_celsius and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}
shareframe_frame_uv_events and on (serial_number) shareframe_frame_build_info{serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"}

panels.description: Highest CPU temperature since boot and under-voltage/throttle events counted since boot.

panels.title: Device events

targets.expr: {job="backend", logger="frames.telemetry"} |= `"kind": "event"` |= "$search" | regexp ` - (?P<payload>\{"kind".*\})$` | line_format `{{.payload}}` | json | serial_number=~"$frame" | line_format `{{.serial_number}}  {{.time}}  [{{.source}}] {{.message}}`

panels.description: Persistent device event log shipped with each heartbeat: boots, crashes, OOM kills, updates, WiFi fallbacks, remote commands. Frame time, not ingest time.

panels.title: Heartbeat payloads

targets.expr: {job="backend", serial_number=~".+", serial_number=~"$frame", version=~"$version", os_sha=~"$os_sha", app_sha=~"$app_sha"} |= "$search" | regexp `log - (?:b')?(?P<payload>\{.*\})'?$` | line_format `{{.payload}}` | json

panels.description: The raw telemetry JSON each frame posted. Use Search to grep it.
